notes.title: Steam Community Items are here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111418/795fd9fac8b8795dfddc7067a6c20f884b93b51c.png[/img]
Hi there!

It's been a while, so I will get straight to the point. Steam Community Items are finally here! By playing the game you can earn some trading cards and craft adorable badges if you wish to. Backgrounds and emoticons are also available (as a reward for crafting the badge or on the Steam Market) so check them out too :3 

Badges preview (Lvl 1-5 and Foil):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111418/53f99721567db775f595ab89e53552226105e6ae.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111418/2e4fee194b4eb248601c5e1fd8617e33a840d92b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111418/b9ee10c68bb913c8b722f1e5482df4f3064aa396.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111418/18997fa2a191c5118e0036817f03f1d1631b4453.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111418/2e4a63e53d64140cd01fc489e7e718ca160ab840.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41111418/84b09f27f0122102bc5341905c8596c5e3522fc6.png[/img]

We hope you like these items as much as we do :3

I wanted also to say... thank you! For playing the game, supporting us, reviewing the game or leaving us a feedback. It really helped us a lot. It was a long road to release the game first on Steam and later on consoles (Xbox and Switch) without any external publisher. As a small 2-person studio it wasn't easy, but we made it and with good winds we are here to stay. So expect to hear more from us in the future, as we are working on our next title.

Stay tuned and stay safe <3
Catthia Games

Trading card renders made by [url=https://x.com/_Admixon_]Admixon[/url]
Badges made by [url=https://x.com/naiconix]Naiconix[/url]
Emoticons made by BeautiDuwanger

___

Ah and by the way, Cynthia is on the deepest discount right now (-45%), so if you haven't played it yet, you might want to grab it now :3

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685730/Cynthia_Hidden_in_the_Moonshadow/

notes.title: CYNTHIA IS OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hi :3

[b]Cynthia is out now![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685730/Cynthia_Hidden_in_the_Moonshadow/

It was such a long journey, it took us 3 years to be here. Working on it almost every single day and now the game is ready to be released. It feels surreal, but we are super proud of what we achieved here without much prior experience and very minimal budget. It's our first title and we don't know what the future brings. Hopefully we will be able to work on this and next projects to deliver even more games to you. For now we hope you will enjoy the game. We put our hearts in it and we can't wait to hear your opinions so make sure to let us know.

Enjoy and have a nice day!

notes.title: Cynthia Demo Patch 1.0.21
notes.notes:
Hi there!

So many things have been changed since the last time so let's jump straight into the patch notes :)

[b]Demo Patch Notes 1.0.21:[/b]
-Added jump ability
-Added dodge ability
-From now on enemies can be shot
-Added sprint ability
-Added stamina bar
-Camera system is reworked - no more weird offsets and movements on Camera when aiming
-Bushes are now swapped to tall grass to improve clarity in which places Player can actually hide
-Control mapper window is reworked
-Lake puzzle is slightly reworked
-Uncle Diego finally fixed the bridge (New bridge model and no more weird cutscene)
-Small change in the loading UI
-Added new popup window to ensure that player want to start a new game when previous save file exist
-Added small tip in the crafting window
-Fixed issue with very high pitch sound
-Fixed issue with floaty aim, now should be more precise (Please let me know if there is any issue with sensitivity)
